# Document persistent filter changes on a finder option

getViewIndexForMsgHdr(aMsgHdr, aForceFind) can call setMailView(All, null) and clear showUnreadOnly when a header is missing. These changes persist, rather than applying only to one lookup. The current JSDoc says this explicitly. The normal filter setter test also shows that assigning showUnreadOnly=false changes special-thread view state. Manual API proposal for this family: document such side effects beside the optional flag and its default; a method named get or find must not be assumed read-only. This does not require renaming the legacy method or replacing every optional flag with an options object.

Scope: message-view-filtering.
